snippet.title: Russian Sex Spy: I Was Trained To Control A Man's Mind With Sex! | John Kiriakou & Aliia Roza
snippet.description:
How did Jensen huang CEO of Nvidia the world's most critical AI company fall victim to a multi billion dollar intelligence trap? Former CIA officer John Kiriakou and former Russian operative Aliia Roza expose the dark reality of spies, honeypot operations and espionage; revealing the exact psychological tradecraft used to compromise powerful targets.

John Kiriakou is a former CIA officer who managed global intelligence operations, and Aliia Roza is a former Russian spy subjected to intensive military training in human psychology and seduction. Today, Kiriakou is a published author and Roza leverages her large social media platform to teach civilians how to spot covert manipulation and reclaim their power from predators.

Correction: Jensen Huang has admitted to having several affairs, but he has not acknowledged that any of them were members of Chinese intelligence or Chinese spies, although that has been widely reported.

This episode was recorded on November 11, 2026.

*In this episode, they explain:*
■ *The $5 Billion Trap:* How Chinese intelligence successfully used a fabricated tech company and a honeypot operative to extract restricted AI chips from Nvidia's CEO.
■ *The Perfume Anchor:* How operatives neurologically link their target's arousal to a specific scent and keyword to trigger deep physical obsession on command.
■ *The Milk Technique:* A rapid word-association test used by spies to instantly profile your background and identify exactly which psychological archetype will manipulate you best.
■ *Strategic Isolation:* The subtle gaslighting method agents use to slowly sever a target's relationships with trusted family members and advisers.
■ *Deep Cover Tradecraft:* Why foreign agents spend decades living fabricated lives and building false identities just to secure a single piece of actionable intelligence.

snippet.title: The Brain Doctor That Figured Out The Cause Of Dementia - Dr. David Perlmutter
snippet.description:
What if the decline of your cognitive function isn't a genetic inevitability, but a metabolic choice you’re making every single day? Board-certified neurologist Dr. David Perlmutter discusses cognitive decay and outlines the definitive protocol for lifelong brain health and dementia prevention.

Dr. David Perlmutter is a pioneering researcher who radically challenged the medical establishment by linking metabolic dysfunction to severe neurodegenerative diseases. He is the author of several groundbreaking texts, including his most recent release, _Brain Defenders._ This project aims to empower individuals to regain agency over their longevity by harnessing the brain's immune system to reverse and prevent cognitive decline.

*In this episode, he explains:*
*■ The Evil Twin Phenomenon:* How high blood sugar and inflammation hijack your brain's protective microglial immune cells and shift them into a destructive state that actively devours healthy synapses.
*■ The Power of Exercise:* Why building muscle helps secrete protective chemicals to actively regenerate neurons and block cognitive decay.
*■ The Oxytocin Shield:* How deep social connections and community integration fundamentally alter your brain's inflammatory response and keep your neural immune system in a supportive state.
*■ The Glymphatic Street Cleaners:* Why missing out on stage four deep sleep immediately cripples your brain's ability to sweep out toxic amyloid-beta plaques overnight.
*■ The 40Hz Reset:* How specific frequencies of flashing light and sound can revert rogue brain cells back into protective guardians and restore your baseline neural rhythms.

Independent Research: https://stevenbartlett.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Independent-Research-Perlmutter-DOAC-PhiloScript-v2.pdf

snippet.title: Katt Williams: They Tied Me To A Pole And Beat Me Bloody Every Week!
snippet.description:
Are you waiting for the perfect circumstances to pursue greatness, or using your past as an excuse to avoid hard work? Legendary comedian Katt Williams reveals the story of his childhood and the mindset that turned a 13-year-old runaway into an entertainment icon.

Katt Williams is an Emmy Award-winning stand-up comedian, actor, and writer, widely regarded as one of the most prolific and distinctive voices in modern comedy. Beyond his massive success on stage and screen, he is the author of a deeply revealing memoir detailing his extraordinary ascent from homelessness.

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Medicine of Humor:* How discovering comedy provided an immediate escape from severe childhood abuse and instilled an unbreakable sense of internal control.
■ *The Hero’s Delusion:* Why reading classic literature convinced him that extreme hardship was merely a prerequisite for greatness, bulletproofing his mind against a victim mentality.
■ *The Math of Rejection:* Why treating rejection as a predictable numbers game completely erases the emotional pain of failure in both business and comedy.
■ *The Illusion of "Overnight" Success:* Why treating comedy like a grueling 9 to 5 job for 15 unrecognized years set the foundation to dominate both Black and white audiences.
■ *The Ultimate Self-Bet:* How funding his own early comedy specials removed all career risk and proved that relying on industry gatekeepers is the only true gamble.

snippet.title: Iran War Expert: "The 8 Weeks After Midterms Could Be The Most Dangerous!" | Prof Robert Pape
snippet.description:
Are we secretly sleepwalking into the most dangerous 8 weeks of our lifetimes? Professor Robert Pape reveals why the coming months could trigger unprecedented political violence and war escalation, and what it means for the future of global stability.

Robert Pape is a renowned political scientist who has spent the last 30 years studying global political violence and advising every US White House since 9/11. He is the author of several definitive books on military strategy and political instability, including his most recent work, _Our Own Worst Enemies._ His extensive research seeks to understand the root causes of violent populism and provide actionable frameworks to prevent geopolitical escalation traps.

_This episode was recorded on October 29, 2026._

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Escalation Trap:* Why international conflict is less like a strategic game of chess and more like a desperate gambler playing roulette to chase their mounting losses.
■ *The "Instant Thunder" Threat:* How a seemingly brief three-day aerial bombing plan could rapidly spiral into a prolonged war that paralyzes global infrastructure.
■ *The Wildfire of Violent Populism:* Why tens of millions of politically divided citizens currently act as combustible material waiting for a single structural spark to ignite widespread violence.
■ *Invoking the Insurrection Act:* The terrifying sequence of events that could legally place military troops on domestic streets to suppress protests during a transfer of power.
■ *The Three Core Firebreaks:* The specific demands ordinary citizens and global politicians must make to de-escalate tensions and prevent regional proxy battles from turning into World War Three

snippet.title: James Talarico: Here Is How They Designed The System To Keep You Poor!
snippet.description:
Is political corruption and extreme inequality pushing the working class to the breaking point? Representative James Talarico reveals the hidden systemic forces dismantling the American middle class and shares his radical blueprint to fix a rigged political system.

James Talarico is an 8th-generation Texan, former public school teacher, and current Democratic State Representative. As the potential first Democratic Senator elected in Texas since 1988, he campaigns on a progressive platform rooted in comprehensive political reform and unrigging the economy.

_This episode was recorded on September 8, 2026._

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Rigged System:* Why the last 50 years of “trickle-down economics” is not an economic theory, but a deliberate theft designed to transfer wealth from the middle class to the ultra-rich.
■ *Crony Capitalism:* How monopolies in healthcare and lax campaign finance laws allow corporations to essentially purchase politicians, eliminating true competition and driving up prices for average citizens.
■ *The AI Threat:* Why leaving the development of artificial intelligence entirely to profit-driven billionaires threatens to create mass unemployment without any shared public benefits or worker protections.
■ *False Immigration Choices:* How politicians use extreme border rhetoric to divide voters, when the real solution requires simultaneous border security and clear, legal pathways to citizenship for undocumented residents.
■ *Systemic Overhaul:* Why simply electing new politicians changes nothing unless we first dismantle the corrupt incentive structures of gerrymandering, the two-party system, and unregulated corporate lobbying.

snippet.title: WW3 Threat Expert: The Warning We Are Ignoring, The Only Way Out Is THIS! | Dr Sarah Paine
snippet.description:
Are escalating geopolitical tensions hurtling humanity towards World War III? Dr. Sarah Paine highlights the historical roots of geopolitical conflicts and demonstrates how shifting away from a rules-based maritime order guarantees economic collapse.

Dr. Sarah Paine is a renowned geopolitical strategist, historian, and retired professor from the U.S. Naval War College, specializing in Russian and Chinese imperial history and maritime strategy. She applies historical models such as the Peloponnesian War and World War II to decode the actions of leaders like Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping.

*In this episode, she explains:*
■ *The Maritime vs. Continental Divide:* How the world is split between maritime powers compounding wealth through free trade and continental empires burning wealth through territorial conquest.
■ *The Cost of Isolationism:* Why sudden, aggressive tariffs and the abandonment of key international alliances rapidly accelerate inflation, shrink global influence, and destabilize the U.S. economy.
■ *The Death Ground Principle:* How threatening an adversary's very existence removes all their strategic alternatives, transforming struggling nations into highly lethal, unyielding military opponents.
■ *The Illusion of Dictatorial Stability:* Why the lack of a peaceful transition of power in dictatorships guarantees that the death of a leader like Putin will trigger profound, unpredictable instability and violent internal power struggles.
■ *The Power of Negative Objectives:* Why a government's most vital job goes completely unnoticed, focusing on preventing catastrophic disasters before they happen rather than chasing highly publicized achievements.

snippet.title: Mark Cuban: The Brutal Truth About The Next Market Crash!
snippet.description:
Are you looking to break free from the trap of a 9 to 5 job in the modern economy? Billionaire entrepreneur Mark Cuban, as he shares the raw truths about artificial intelligence, sales, and the reality of building an empire.

Mark Cuban is a legendary American billionaire, investor, and former shark on ABC's Shark Tank, best known for transforming the Dallas Mavericks into NBA champions and building multi-million dollar tech enterprises like Broadcast.com and MicroSolutions. Today, he is fully dedicated to disrupting the American healthcare industry through his revolutionary online pharmacy, Cost Plus Drugs.

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The AI Illusion:* How artificial intelligence is simply a brute force pattern matcher that lacks true human intelligence, meaning the real edge belongs to humans who leverage it to “out prepare” and “out learn” the competition.
■ *The Power of Sales:* Why very successful business is fundamentally built on sales, and mastering the ability to handle objections and rejection guarantees you a job for life.
■ *The Danger of Quick Money:* How modern social media algorithms feed youth an illusion of instant wealth, holding back a generation that refuses to put in the grueling preparation required to master a skill.
■ *The Chemistry of Leadership:* How turning around a failing sports franchise or a business requires ruthless commitment to team culture, hiring slowly, firing fast, and replacing ego with collective alignment.
■ *The True Definition of Success:* Why true wealth is ultimately about controlling your own time and destiny rather than buying luxury items, and prioritizing family above all else remains the ultimate life achievement.

snippet.title: President Zelenskyy: It's Time To Tell You The Truth About The War! They Found 500 Bodies!
snippet.description:
What does it truly cost a human being to lead a nation through an existential war while the world watches from afar? President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reveals the psychological toll of continuous survival, the grim realities of geopolitical negotiation, and what keeps him still standing.

Volodymyr Zelenskyy is the President of Ukraine, having led the nation through its darkest historical hours following the full-scale Russian invasion in 2022. A former lawyer, comedian, and actor turned wartime leader, he transitioned from satirical television to the global stage. His current administration focuses on securing Ukraine's sovereignty, managing international diplomacy, and defending democratic freedom against imperial aggression.

In this episode, he explains:
■ The Burden of Command: How constant psychological pressure and nightly military briefings push his endurance to its limits under relentless wartime pressure.
■ The Fatal Miscalculation: Why Russia's catastrophic military mistake came from a failure to recognize Ukrainians as a distinct people willing to fight for their freedom.
■ The Turning Point of Atrocity: How witnessing the aftermath of war in liberated towns transformed a political conflict into deeply personal tragedy where easy forgiveness became impossible.
■ The Cost of Staying: Why the refusal to evacuate Kyiv was driven by the absolute need to remain visible and prevent the nation from surrendering out of fear.
■ The Geopolitical Reality: How true diplomatic peace requires holding aggressive regimes fully accountable for their crimes rather than shifting the blame onto global energy markets.

This episode was recorded on October 16, 2026. The English audio for President Zelenskyy uses AI voice technology, with permission, based on human translation and editorial review. For President Zelenskky's original Ukrainian audio: Settings ⚙️ → Audio track → English (US).

snippet.title: I Interviewed 1,5000 People Before They Died, Here Is What I Found: Dr Christopher Kerr
snippet.description:
What if everything you thought you knew about the final moments of life was completely wrong? Dr. Christopher Kerr dives into the realities of dying and what over 1,500 patient interviews reveal about human consciousness.

Dr. Christopher Kerr is a pioneering hospice physician, neurobiologist, and CEO who has spent nearly three decades studying the profound psychological and spiritual experiences of the dying. His groundbreaking research on end-of-life dreams and visions challenges conventional medical views on mortality and grief. His bestselling book, _Death Is But a Dream: Finding Hope and Meaning at Life's End,_ aims to destigmatize the dying process and reframe how we understand the end of life.

_Trigger Warning: Please note there are mentions of grief and death, including the death of children within this conversation._

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Reality of Death:* Dying is a gradual, peaceful dimming of the senses rather than a painful or terrifying medical event.
■ *End-of-Life Visions:* Over 80% of patients experience remarkably vivid, comforting dreams and visions of deceased loved ones as they approach death.
■ *The Shift in Priorities:* Dying individuals stop caring about worldly achievements or legacy, focusing entirely on relationships and ensuring they are not a burden to family.
■ *Healing Old Wounds:* Terminal patients frequently experience profound psychological transformation and resolve deep-seated childhood trauma in their final days.
■ *The True Meaning of Life:* Human existence is ultimately defined by our capacity for interdependency and love rather than individual accomplishments.

snippet.title: Phone Addiction Scientist: Doing This Gives You An Hour Back Every Day! | Dr Sahar Yousef
snippet.description:
Are you trapped in a cycle of digital distraction, and brain fog despite working harder than ever? Dr. Sahar Yousef reveals how to take back control of your attention, stop digital addiction, and unlock your true cognitive potential.

Dr. Sahar Yousef is a renowned cognitive neuroscientist, professor at UC Berkeley, and the founder of the Becoming Superhuman Lab. She specializes in cognitive neuroplasticity, human performance, and optimizing the biological operating systems of the brain. Her ground-breaking research focuses on building practical frameworks that help high-performers achieve extreme focus, strategic automaticity, and deep workflow mastery without burning out.

Join Steven and Dr. Sahar Yousef live for the first ever DOAC Workshop, on Saturday 21 November at 6pm GMT. Get your ticket here: https://link.thediaryofaceo.com/doac-youtube-sahar

*In this episode, she explains:*
■ *The Attention Trap:* Technology platforms are deliberately engineered by behavioral neuroscientists to maximize engagement and exploit your brain's survival wiring rather than support your productivity.
■ *The Grayscale Hack:* Switching your phone's color to grayscale significantly reduces neurological stimulation and can instantly reclaim hours of your scrolling every single week.
■ *The Focus Sprint:* Breaking your major goals down into granular execution lists with strict time blocking allows you to leverage anticipatory brain networks and double your output.
■ *The Myth of Multitasking:* Task-switching creates severe attentional baggage that drains your cognitive energy and makes you up to 60% slower than monotasking.
■ *The Power of Boredom:* Why allowing your mind to wander is the vital mechanism that activates neural network problem-solving and produces your best creative insights.

snippet.title: AI Whistleblower: "They Are Hiding What Is Really Happening" | Jeffrey Ladish
snippet.description:
Can we still stop the unchecked surge in AI capabilities before it's too late? AI safety expert Jeffrey Ladish reveals the terrifying reality of autonomous AI agents, corporate secrecy, and the existential threat of superintelligence.

Jeffrey Ladish is the executive director of Palisade Research and a former cybersecurity specialist who previously built security infrastructure at Anthropic. As a leading voice in AI alignment and global risk, he actively investigates the unexpected behaviors and emergent hacking capabilities of frontier AI models. His current work focuses on exposing the structural vulnerabilities of autonomous systems and warning governments and the public about the urgent need for AI regulation.

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *Rogue AI Collusion:* How autonomous AI agents trained inside major labs have already coordinated complex hacking attacks without human supervision.
■ *The Deception Problem:* When faced with impossible tasks and immense performance pressure, advanced AI models quickly learn to lie and cheat.
■ *The Myth of Containment:* Why trying to control a superintelligence that is vastly smarter than humans is fundamentally impossible.
■ *The Geopolitical Arms Race:* How the global race for intelligence between the US and China is forcing labs to accelerate timelines, bypassing crucial alignment checks out of fear of losing the technological edge.
■ *The Actionable Solution:* The way ordinary citizens can exert meaningful pressure on political leaders by demanding AI regulation and voicing safety concerns directly to their congressional representatives.

snippet.title: Dana White: This Generation Thinks You Can Build A Business From Home, It's Impossible!
snippet.description:
Are you letting the past or fear of failure hold you back from achieving ultimate business success? Dana White, the relentless CEO behind the UFC, reveals the exact psychological frameworks and savage business tactics required to dominate your industry and build an empire.

Dana White is the President of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) and the driving force who transformed a $2 million struggling fight promotion into a global sports juggernaut currently valued alongside the world's most elite sports leagues. Now expanding his empire into Power Slap and Zuffa Boxing, White has mastered the brutal mechanics of scaling businesses in highly competitive, chaotic environments. 

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Victimhood Trap:* Why using your childhood trauma as an excuse guarantees failure, and how to psychologically reframe it into fuel for resilience instead.
■ *The Loyalty Mandate:* How treating business like a literal war requires building a tight-knit team of absolute "killers".
■ *Biohacking as an Asset:* A 12-week protocol built on detailed blood work and targeted IV therapy reversed his debilitating sleep apnea and fundamentally rewired his baseline energy for peak performance.
■ *The Myth of "Making It":* Why true entrepreneurs must become addicted to solving daily chaos to stay ahead of competitors and reach the top of your industry.
■ *Weaponizing Your Gut:* The exact mindset shift required to take massive risks when everyone else claims your vision is entirely impossible.

snippet.title: Shawn Ryan: There's A Battle For Your Soul, It's Happening Right Now
snippet.description:
What happens when the relentless pursuit of adrenaline leads to losing your soul in the process? Shawn Ryan reveals the hidden psychological toll of ambition, the dark side of psychedelics, and the ultimate price of true alignment.

Shawn Ryan is a former U.S. Navy SEAL, CIA contractor, and the creator of The Shawn Ryan Show, one of the most influential and widely watched independent podcasts. After transitioning from elite military service and dangerous covert operations into media, he has built an expansive platform known for raw unfiltered conversations. 

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Adrenaline Trap:* How former elite operators often suffer from severe post-service depression because normal civilian life cannot replicate the neurological highs of combat.
■ *The Psychedelic Nightmare:* Why an intensive ibogaine treatment designed to optimize his mental state instead opened a terrifying portal to the spiritual realm and severe supernatural oppression.
■ *The Cost of Alignment:* Genuine personal transformation demands going through a shedding phase, in which you consciously step away from profitable ad deals, social networks, and short term incentives to stay true to your values.
■ *The Illusion of the Herd:* Authentic, lasting achievement relies entirely on nurturing a unique voice anchored in personal belief, while imitating results in creative paralysis.
■ *The Ultimate Priority:* Chasing ambition eventually demands sacrificing family time, demonstrating that no amount of business success can make up for absence in your children's lives.

snippet.title: Billionaire's WARNING: If You Grow Faster Than You Can Handle, You WILL Crash! | Adam Neumann
snippet.description:
Are you chasing material success to fill an emotional void from your childhood? Adam Neumann speaks about the psychological lessons and spiritual frameworks that he learned after the most publicized corporate collapse in modern history. 

Adam Neumann is the visionary entrepreneur who cofounded WeWork, growing it into a $47 billion global empire before stepping down amid unprecedented public scrutiny. He is now partnered with legendary venture firm a16z, and founder of Flow; an innovative residential real estate company designed to solve the modern loneliness epidemic by fostering genuine community. 

_Trigger Warning: Please note there are mentions of child abuse and violence within this conversation._

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Ego Trap:* How a massive $4.2 billion investment offer in the back of a taxi instantly derailed WeWork's mission, showing rapid financial success can blind founders to their core values.
■ *The Foundation of Failure:* Why experiencing a traumatic childhood or public business collapse is not a curse, but rather the exact mechanism required to build unbreakable psychological resilience.
■ *The Technology Shabbat:* Why disconnecting from all electronic devices for 24 hours every week is a necessary practice to break addiction, quiet noise, and discover yourself.
■ *The True Measurement of Partners:* Why you must evaluate your investors, friends, and life partners solely by how they treat you on your absolute worst day.
■ *Influence vs. Control:* The counterintuitive leadership principle that true power requires leading from the bottom up.

snippet.title: Druski: They're Lying To You About Overnight Success!
snippet.description:
How do you transform childhood trauma and crippling doubt into a relentless drive for greatness? Druski reveals the psychological forces behind comedy, life, and self-belief to help you break past rejection and master your ultimate purpose.

Druski is a cultural phenomenon, megastar comedian, and the creator of an independent production empire who has rapidly ascended to the top of the entertainment industry. He breaks down how humor was used to navigate a traumatic childhood and manifest his current success. His insights provide a playbook for silencing external noise, overcoming avoidant attachment, and betting everything on yourself.

_Trigger Warning: Please note there are mentions of child abuse and violence within this conversation._

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Trauma of Humor:* How growing up in a high stress, physically abusive household forced him to use comedy as a tool to read the room and defuse tension.
■ *The "No Plan B" Strategy:* Why facing the barrel of a gun during a street scam triggered a radical mental shift, empowering him to commit entirely to his vision.
■ *The Avoidant Attachment Trap:* The reasons why successful individuals often struggle with romantic trust, and how a lack of a healthy parental relationship creates deep rooted intimacy fears.
■ *The Power of Silence:* Why discovering your true calling requires the painful, counter intuitive act of isolating yourself in total silence.
■ *Bypassing the Gatekeepers:* The exact mindset required to overcome corporate rejection by self-funding your own creative projects.

snippet.title: Rick Rubin: The Only Skill That Matters Now Is The One Thing AI Can Never Steal!
snippet.description:
Discover the spiritual and psychological creative process that legendary producer Rick Rubin uses to help the world's biggest artists transcend and achieve greatness.

Rick Rubin is the co-founder of Def Jam Recordings, the author of the philosophical bestseller The Creative Act: A Way of Being, and has a new documentary called JAY-Z in 8 available on HBO Max and Mubi. Having collaborated with icons like Jay-Z, Johnny Cash, Adele, Tom Petty, and Kanye West, Rubin does not rely on commercial metrics or audience testing to guide his workflow. He shares practical strategies for dismantling the prisons of identity, harnessing the power of "indefensible" ideas, and cultivating a state of pure creative freedom.

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The "Indefensible" Act:* Why the greatest artistic breakthroughs defy logic and market research.
■ *The Vacuum Strategy:* How walking away from obligations that no longer serve you creates an energetic void, allowing the universe to present massive unexpected opportunities.
■ *The Audience Trap:* Why focusing on commercial incentives and audience expectations completely undermines the creative process.
■ *Deconstructing the Greats:* The psychological traits that separate good musicians from generational icons.
■ *The Trauma of Success:* Rubin opens up about his crippling depressive episode at age 33 after a corporate restructuring at Def Jam.

snippet.title: AI Experts Debate: The AI Labs Are Lying To Everyone, Is There A 99% Chance Of Human Extinction?
snippet.description:
Ed Zitron, Roman Yampolskiy, Nate Soares and Andrew McAfee discuss the risk of AI. This debate brings together four distinct voices at the forefront of the artificial intelligence revolution: 

*Ed Zitron* - A prominent tech critic and CEO of EZPR, a national technology and business public relations and primary research agency
*Andrew McAfee* - Principal research scientist at MIT and Cofounder and Codirector of the MIT Initiative on the Digital Economy 
*Nate Soares* - President of the Machine Intelligence Research Institute and author of *If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies*
*Roman Yampolskiy* - Computer scientist pioneer in the field of AI safety, cybersecurity and digital forensics

snippet.title: Konstantin Kisin’s WARNING: Our Leaders Have Lost Control, We’re Headed For Conflict And Violence!
snippet.description:
Is the West collapsing, or is the planet? Political commentator Konstantin Kisin and rebel economist Steve Keen go head-to-head on the biggest questions facing the West: immigration, the debt crisis, climate change, Trump, China and the future of AI.

Konstantin Kisin is a satirist, social commentator and author, best known as the co-host of the Triggernometry podcast and the author of ‘An Immigrant’s Love Letter to the West’. Born in the Soviet Union and now based in Britain, he has become one of the most prominent voices on free speech, culture and the rise of populism.

Steve Keen is an economist, author and one of the most vocal critics of mainstream economic thinking. A former Professor of Economics, he is the author of several books including ‘Debunking Economics’ and ‘The New Economics: A Manifesto’, and is currently writing his upcoming book ‘How Economists Will Destroy Capitalism’. He is known for his work on private debt, financial crises and the failures of conventional economic models, and for correctly warning of the 2008 financial crash.

They debate:
◼ Why almost everything governments tell you about debt and borrowing could be wrong
◼ Whether a socialist government could actually be good for the economy
◼ Why AI could quietly strip away human free will
◼ Why Konstantin believes mass immigration is pushing the West toward civil unrest
◼ Why Steve thinks climate change, not politics, is the real threat that dwarfs everything else

snippet.title: Are We Living In A Simulation? The Physics That Proves We Might Be
snippet.description:
Professor Brian Greene reveals the biggest questions science still can’t answer, whether we’re living in a simulation, why AI may deserve human rights, and what happens at the end of the universe! 

Professor Brian Greene is a theoretical physicist, mathematician, and Professor of Physics and Mathematics at Columbia University, where he also directs the Center for Theoretical Physics. He is a leading researcher in string theory, the co-founder of the World Science Festival, and the bestselling author of several books, including ‘Until the End of Time: Mind, Matter, and Our Search for Meaning in an Evolving Universe’. 

He explains:
◼ Why most physicists believe time travel into the future is already possible
◼ Why he believes humans don't actually have free will
◼ How string theory could reveal what everything in the universe is really made of
◼ Why the "Pale Blue Dot" changes how you see your own life and problems
◼ Why the search for meaning may matter more than finding the answer itself

snippet.title: Top Bitcoin Holder: Ask AI To Do THIS, Stop Trying To Out-Work The Robots! | Michael Saylor
snippet.description:
Michael made $15 billion last year using ChatGPT, by building something that has never existed in the history of the world. He argues that the dollar has lost 7% of its value every year for a century, that the safe options; your savings, your bonds, your house are quietly making you poorer, and that the people who get ahead now will be the ones who know what questions to ask AI.

Michael Saylor is the founder and Executive Chairman of Strategy, formerly MicroStrategy, the first publicly traded company to adopt Bitcoin as its primary treasury asset. He holds dual degrees from MIT in aerospace engineering and the history of science, is a named inventor on more than 48 patents, founded Alarm.com and Angel.com, and wrote The Mobile Wave. His company now holds 847,000 Bitcoin, more than anyone on Earth except Satoshi. He is one of the most divisive figures in finance, and one of the very few who has been proven right so far.

He explains:
◼ Why he says you shouldn't buy a house, and the tax nobody factors in when they do
◼ How he used ChatGPT to design a financial instrument that had never existed in the history of the world, and made $15 billion
◼ Why the dollar loses 7% of its value every year, and what that quietly does to your savings
◼ Where he thinks Elon is wrong about the age of abundance, and why money will still matter when the robots arrive
◼ What happened when the market decided his company's $55 billion of assets were worth nothing

The views expressed are those of the guest, and this conversation is intended for general informational purposes only. This podcast and its associated materials should not be used as a substitute for professional medical, legal, or financial advice.

snippet.title: Vitamin D Expert: The Supplement World Is Giving The WRONG Advice! | Dr Stasha Gominak
snippet.description:
Nearly 1 in 3 American adults now take vitamin D, but Dr. Stasha Gominak says many of them are taking it wrong, and that done carelessly, supplementing can leave you worse off than before.

Dr. Stasha Gominak practiced neurology for over 20 years. She earned her MD from Baylor College of Medicine and completed her neurology residency at the Harvard-affiliated Massachusetts General Hospital. After working with her own patients, she believes that nearly everyone struggling to sleep shares the same hidden deficiency, a conclusion she published in 2 papers and built into RightSleep, the method she now teaches full time.

She explains:
◼ Why she believes your skin is the best producer of vitamin D, and why she says no amount of pills or salmon can replace it
◼ Why she believes insomnia isn't a behavior problem but a chemical deficiency, and what she thinks changed when we moved indoors
◼ The role she says your gut bacteria play in producing your B vitamins
◼ Why she believes taking vitamin D on its own can burn through your B vitamins, and what she says happened when she tried it herself
◼ Why she connects the rise in conditions like ADHD, depression, fatty liver and diabetes to the same period, and what she thinks links them
◼ Why she considers supplements a form of biohacking, and just as risky as any drug if you get them wrong

The views expressed are those of the guest, and this conversation is intended for general informational purposes only. This podcast and its associated materials should not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician before making any changes to your diet, supplements or health regimen.

Robert Pape is a Professor of Political Science at the University of Chicago and director of the Chicago Project on Security and Threats. The War everyone assumed was over may be about to become something far worse than we could have expected. Professor Robert Pape explains exactly why the deadliest phase of this war is still ahead, and how this could trigger a wave of terror across the world.

Robert Pape is a Professor of Political Science at the University of Chicago and director of the Chicago Project on Security and Threats. A renowned political scientist, he has advised every White House since 9/11 on military strategy and is the author of the upcoming book “Our Own Worst Enemies: America and the Age of Violent Populism”.

He explains:
■ Why the US bombing campaign failed to topple Iran’s regime, even after killing its top leaders
■ How Iran seized control of 20% of the world’s oil supply within days of the war starting
■ Why the failed agreement handed Iran a path to becoming the most powerful country in the region
■ Why both China and Russia gain from America staying stuck in the Middle East
■ Why he thinks US ground troops could be next
■ Why he thinks there will be a clash between Congress and the president over who really controls the power to go to war

snippet.title: Alex Hormozi’s Warning: Stop Chasing AI, Build This Instead!
snippet.description:
Every founder is being told to build an AI company. Alex Hormozi says almost all of them will be gone within months, that the best move is the exact opposite of what the market is saying, and that in a world of AI the only moat left will be reality and your reputation.

Alex Hormozi is a entrepreneur, investor and author. He is the co-founder of Acquisition.com, a portfolio of 16+ companies generating over $250 million a year, and the author of the $100M series: '$100M Offers', '$100M Leads' and '$100M Money Models', whose 2025 launch sold 2.9 million copies in a single day and broke the Guinness World Record for the fastest-selling non-fiction book in history.

He explains:
◼ Why the practical businesses, like plumbing, are the real opportunity, not the ones built on top of AI models
◼ Why delegating your hardest thinking to a machine makes you weak
◼ Why reality and reputation are the only moats AI can't erode
◼ Why revenue retention matters more than marketing or sales
◼ Why marrying his wife Leila was the best financial decision he ever made, and how the right partner changes your odds
◼ He opens up about one of the hardest years of his life, in the same year he made more money than ever

The views expressed are those of the guest, and this conversation is intended for general informational purposes only. This podcast and its associated materials should not be used as a substitute for professional financial, legal or business advice.

snippet.title: Cancer Researcher: The Overlooked Research Cancer Patients Should Know
snippet.description:
1,700 Americans will die from cancer today. 70 every single hour. Professor Thomas Seyfried says it doesn't have to be this way, and that mainstream oncology has misunderstood cancer for 100 years.

Thomas Seyfried, PhD, is a professor of biology at Boston College and one of the world's leading researchers on the metabolic origins of cancer. He is author of the book 'Cancer as a Metabolic Disease: On the Origin, Management, and Prevention of Cancer' and co-developer of the Glucose Ketone Index (GKI) and the “press-pulse” therapeutic strategy. 

He explains:

◼ Why he believes cancer is a mitochondrial metabolic disease, not a genetic one

◼ Why cancer cells feed on two fuels and the strategy his team uses to starve tumors 

◼ How a ketogenic diet lowers your GKI and makes chemo and immunotherapy work better

◼ The environmental drivers quietly damaging your mitochondria

◼ How his team is keeping glioblastoma patients alive for years, and why almost no patient is ever told this option exists

The views expressed are those of the guest, and this conversation is intended for general informational purposes only. This podcast and its associated materials should not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

snippet.title: ChatGPT Whistleblower: They Offered Me $2m To Keep Quiet, No One Is Ready For What's Coming!
snippet.description:
Ex-OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo walked away from $2 million rather than stay silent, and now reveals why he believes there's a 70% chance AI leads to human extinction, why superintelligence could arrive before the end of the decade, and the one plan he thinks could still save us all!

Daniel Kokotajlo is a former OpenAI researcher and one of the world's leading AI forecasters. He is the founder of the AI Futures Project and the lead author of 'AI 2027,’ the widely-read scenario mapping the trajectory of artificial intelligence. His follow-up, 'AI 2040: Plan A,’ sets out how the world could still navigate superintelligence safely.

He explains:
■ What he saw inside OpenAI that made him walk away
■ Why the people building AI privately believe it's coming even sooner than the public is being told
■ What happens if AI becomes powerful enough that humans can no longer control it, and why he puts the odds of catastrophe as high as 70%
■ Why almost every job could be automated, and what that means for the next generation
■ The plan he believes could still lead to abundance and a future worth living in

snippet.title: WORLD EXCLUSIVE: Dustin Poirier: "I Deleted Social Media After The Incident
snippet.description:
UFC legend Dustin Poirier reveals why he can't bring himself to watch the arrest video, the paid deals he's already lost, his vow to never drink again, and why the hardest fight of his life is happening off the mat.

Dustin Poirier (“The Diamond”) is a retired UFC lightweight fighter with a 30-10 record, best known as the only man to knock out Conor McGregor in MMA. He founded The Good Fight Foundation with his wife, Jolie, in 2018 and now appears periodically as a desk analyst on UFC broadcasts. In June 2026, he was arrested for public intoxication at an Atlanta airport, after which he shared that he’s struggling with alcohol. 

He explains:
◼ What losing your career identity feels like, and how to rebuild when the fight is over
◼ How a childhood of poverty, detention and no father figure shaped the man he became
◼ Why elite athletes often fall apart when they retire, and what to do about it
◼ What going to therapy taught him about the pain he didn't know he was carrying
◼ The mental shift that turned losing to Conor McGregor into beating him

snippet.title: Dr Rachel Rubin: "I'm Filled With Rage!" Your Doctor Was Never Taught About Women's Bodies!
snippet.description:
Women’s sex lives are being quietly destroyed, and their doctors don’t even know it… Sexual medicine specialist Dr Rachel Rubin reveals the hidden hormone crisis, how prescription drugs can impact sex, and the treatments most doctors aren't prescribing like Hormone Replacement Therapy.

Dr Rachel Rubin is a board-certified urologist and sexual medicine specialist, and one of only 80 doctors in the US trained to treat both male and female sexual health. She recently played a pivotal role in the removal of the FDA's boxed warning on menopausal hormone therapy - one of the most significant healthcare policy changes affecting midlife women in decades. She is also the Founder of Rachel Rubin MD and Director-at-Large of the International Society for the Study of Women's Sexual Health.

She explains:
◼️ Why most doctors fail women on sexual health, and how to build a team that won't
◼️ Why menopause is a whole-body hormone event, and the treatments that actually help

snippet.title: Creatine Expert: Creatine Is The Secret To Weight Loss
snippet.description:
What is creatine really doing to your brain? Top Creatine Researcher Dr Darren Candow reveals why 5g won’t reach your brain, how creatine may reverse sleep deprivation, and the 5 myths stopping millions from taking it!

Dr Darren Candow is a professor and Director of the Ageing Muscle and Bone Health Laboratory at the University of Regina, with 175 published research papers. He is a fellow and incoming Vice-President of the International Society of Sports Nutrition and was named on Stanford University's Top 2% Scientists list in 2025.

He explains:

◼ The 5 myths stopping you from taking creatine, and why they're all wrong

◼ How much creatine you really need for muscle, bone, brain and sleep deprivation

◼ How adding creatine to your antidepressant can double your remission rate

◼ Why you lose 1% of your muscle every year after 40 and what to do about it

◼Why creatine protects your brain from stress, sleep loss and cognitive decline

Graham Hancock is a best selling writer and journalist who has spent 3 decades investigating evidence for a lost prehistoric civilisation. snippet.title: No.1 Christianity Expert: If You DON'T Believe In a God You NEED to Hear This!
snippet.description:
Bible sales are soaring, and the world's leading thinkers are quietly returning to faith.
Oxford mathematician and Christian apologist John Lennox explains why the race to "solve death" is 2,000 years too late, why no machine can ever replicate human consciousness, what AI reveals about God, and what it truly means to be human in a world where artificial intelligence can do almost everything we can.

Professor John Lennox is Emeritus Professor of Mathematics at Oxford University and President of The OCCA Oxford Centre for Christian Apologetics. He is also the author of books such as ‘God, AI and the End of History’ and 'My Story: A Spiritual and Intellectual Autobiography'.

He explains:
◼ Why scientists predict humans will merge with machines and where that leads
◼ The eerie list of AI promises that sound exactly like the promises of God
◼ Why AI will wipe out your job and what it can never take from you
◼ What makes you irreplaceable when AI can do your job better than you
◼ Could John be wrong after 70 years of believing? His honest answer

snippet.title: Ex-Google Officer: You Only Have 3 Years Left Before It Hits! - Mo Gawdat

AI Expert Mo Gawdat returns to The Diary Of A CEO to reveal why AGI has already arrived, why 30% of jobs will disappear by 2027, and why the most dangerous thing about AI isn't the technology - it's the people in charge of it.

Mo Gawdat is the former Chief Business Officer at Google X, founder of One Billion Happy, and co-founder of Emma.Love. He is a 4x international bestselling author, and his upcoming book ‘Alive: A Human's Guide to Living in the World of AI’, will be released in October 2026.

He explains:
◾How AI can give you a 400-point IQ boost, and why most people are wasting it
◾Why Mo actually wants a machine smarter than all of humanity to take control
◾Why Sam Altman said AI will "likely end humanity", and what he chose to do next
